config.expression: if((coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeUnackCount')), 0), 0) + coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeAckCount')), 0), 0)) = 0, 'No active alarms', toStr((coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeUnackCount')), 0), 0) + coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeAckCount')), 0), 0))) + ' active alarm' + if((coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeUnackCount')), 0), 0) + coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeAckCount')), 0), 0)) = 1, '', 's') + if(coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeUnackCount')), 0), 0) > 0, ' (' + toStr(coalesce(try(toInt(tag(if(right({view.params.tagPath}, 1) = ']', {view.params.tagPath}, {view.params.tagPath} + '/') + 'Alarm Metrics.activeUnackCount')), 0), 0)) + ' unacknowledged)', ''))

messageHandlers.script:
# Ticket Logger context-menu opener
	# page-scoped: every view on the page hears it - only the view whose menu was clicked acts
	sender = payload.get('sender')
	if sender and sender != self.view.id:
		return
	shared.Alerts.contextMenuTicketLog(payload['tagPath'], payload['viewName'])
